plan.title: bug(roadmap:render): ignore bare -- as outPath (POSIX separator mis-route)

narratives.Description: bug(roadmap:render): bare -- is treated as outPath (POSIX separator mis-routes ROADMAP write)
narratives.Overview:
## Finding

`deft roadmap:render -- --project-root <root>` treats the bare `--` token as a **positional output path**, so ROADMAP content is written to a file literally named `--` and stdout reports `Rendered ROADMAP.md to --`.

DCR R.4756 (deftai/DevHammer) used that argv shape and then read `ROADMAP.md`, producing a false `active_section=False title=False` fail even though the active brief rendered correctly into the dash file.

Without the bare `--`, `roadmap:render --project-root <root>` writes `ROADMAP.md` with `## Active` as expected (product #5206).

Parent false-fail triage: deftai/directive#4756 → deftai/DevHammer#419 (oracle drops `--`). This issue is the **Directive polish**: ignore bare `--` as POSIX end-of-options so agents/consumers that insert a separator do not mis-route `outPath`.

## Bound remedy (proposed)

In `packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts` `main()`:

- When argv token is exactly `--`, treat it as end-of-options / ignore (do not push onto `positional`).
- Keep real positional outPath and pending-dir override behavior for non-`--` args.
- Add a unit test that `main(["--", "--project-root", root])` writes `ROADMAP.md` (not a file named `--`) and lists active scopes.

## Non-goals

- Re-opening the #4756 empty-claim / no-flag PD design.
- Changing `--project-root` / `--check` semantics beyond ignoring bare `--`.

## Refs

- DCR false fail: #4756 / R.4756 / `det.roadmap_render_lists_active`
- Harbor/oracle tracker: https://github.com/deftai/DevHammer/issues/419
- Product list-active ship: #5206

sentences: Before the flag loop in packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts main(): if argv includes --help or -h, print usage and return 0.
In the loop: if arg === "--", continue (ignore; do not push; no end-of-options latch).
Else if arg.startsWith("-") and is not --project-root / --project-root= / --check, print Unknown flag + usage and return 2.
Keep real positional outPath / pending-dir override for non-dash tokens.
